atmospheric_confidence.note: Each atmospheric system backed by 5-6 independent published estimates + Kramers escape rate verification. Strongest multi-method confirmation in the dataset.

v1_lesson: Naive extension to 19 systems fails (R²=-1.49). Universality holds for strong-coupling regime only.
v2_lesson: Standard 2D/3D magnets, glass transitions, and perovskites all fail. Formula requires E and T* set by different physics — genuine potential energy barriers parametrically independent of transition temperature.
